The '''CLL-M2 binary lifter''', also known as the '''CLL-M2 ordnance loadlifter''' or simply the '''pincer droid''', was [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica's]] military version of their [[CLL-6 binary load lifter droid]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:CLLM2-GAW.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A CLL-M2 loads missiles into a [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing starfighter]]]]
The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] stood on powerful [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] legs, which in turn were anchored by two [[magnapod]] disks. It had extremely thick armor to protect it from attacks and accidental detonations of ammunition.<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> Its arms were made to handle cargo skids and missiles, while the primitive cognitive module stood at the center of the droid, covered by a single, large [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]]. A [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] drive on the droid's back allowed it to compensate for lifting cargo heavier than itself. The droid was set to obey verbal commands by its operators, but only spoke [[Binary/Legends|Binary]] itself. It was not particularly bright, but it was programmed to handle ammunition, reload weapons and perform basic repairs.<ref name="GAW" /> It cost 15,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new.<ref name="GAW" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commanders]] would send in teams of CLL-M2 ordnance lifter to [[Scavenger/Legends|rescue]] any reusable scraps of machinery when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] destroyed [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] or military bases.<ref name="Ultimate Sticker Book">''[[Ultimate Sticker Book: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[The Droids of Episode III: It's a Junkyard Smackdown!|''The Droids of Episode III'']] and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' both give this model a height of 3 meters, though ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'' claims a height of 6.7 meters.
